source_diversity_policy.purpose: Review every registered public event source for each new issue; avoid concentration and falsely assuming registered means scanned.
source_diversity_policy.saturday_and_sunday: EVERY registered source must be attempted and editorially accounted for during Saturday preparation and Sunday completion, not just a rotating sample. The current registry length is derived from sources[], never hard-coded in automation instructions.
source_diversity_policy.scanning_accountability: For each issue from 006, record one truthful research_coverage.source_scans entry per live registry source ID (100% coverage): actual organizer or public calendar pages checked, timestamp, named reviewer, source-specific finding, candidate event links or no-fit reason, and blocked evidence plus retries. Public HTTP reachability is only a probe, NOT an editorial review. Do not invent visits. Report blocked sources distinctly; no silent unscanned sources.
source_diversity_policy.editorial_selection: Select events by personal relevance and freshness; reviewed sites need not be featured. No requirement to include events from any particular organizer.
source_diversity_policy.personal_priority: Lumen Project is the user's favorite Stockholm music experience: monitor its rare announcements and future dates without requiring frequent events.
source_diversity_policy.aggregators: Discover via Visit Stockholm, Luma Stockholm + category and curated community calendars, Meetup Stockholm, Tickster Stockholm, Nattljud, Resident Advisor, Evenemang Stockholm, Slakthusguiden, and Stockholm Events cross-platform; ALWAYS verify on the original organizer's current public event page. Luma public pages do not need login, but private/member-only/approved details are not accessible without authorization.
source_diversity_policy.removed_source: Slakthusen removed as user-requested preferred venue; Fållan added instead.
source_diversity_policy.access_policy: Never sign in, circumvent membership, infer hidden addresses or RSVP capacity, or claim current bookings merely from listing. Record access limitation or unknown availability instead. Prefer uniquely interesting participatory, music, art and AI events instead of generic professional networking.
source_diversity_policy.overlap_policy: Deduplicate event leads across Luma, Meetup, Tickster and indexes using original host, date and canonical event URL; do not count the same event repeatedly as additional discovery, and measure unique organizer domains separately from aggregator sources.
source_diversity_policy.luma_explicit_check: Every Saturday and Sunday, attempt public Luma Stockholm city index AND all additional_discovery_urls in the live registry; review promising dated public event pages, log original host, date, price and availability uncertainty. Never require login or fabricate member-only details. Report no-fit/blocked with source-specific evidence.
source_diversity_policy.new_source_rotation: Rotate attention and editorial depth only AFTER attempting ALL registry sources. Prioritize small independent organizers in the shortlist without skipping any public registered calendar. Failure to access a source requires retried attempts and alternative public search, not false 'reviewed' status.
source_diversity_policy.mandatory_source_review: From Issue 006: mandatory complete registry accounting and per-source actual editorial evaluation, checked in the GitHub production release gate by source_coverage.py. Every source must be reviewed_leads, reviewed_no_fit, or blocked_after_retry with evidence. >20% blocked is incomplete. Existing Issue 005 grandfathered to avoid changing already sent content.
source_diversity_policy.automated_public_probe: GitHub Action 'Sweep every registered public source (no email)' runs before Saturday and Sunday, and publishes research/source-probe.json to branch source-audit. It attempts every source and Luma categories and gathers unverified lead URLs; it does not count as an editorial review. Editorial agent MUST follow links to current original event pages and fill issue research_coverage.source_scans.
